title: Strings & ciphers
hints: README 'New syntax': ord/chr do arithmetic on letters, `mod` 26 wraps, isLower/isUpper pick the base letter.

caesar: map a per-character shift over the text: lowercase letters rotate around 'a', uppercase around 'A', anything else stays. rot13: caesar with 13 (point-free). isPalindrome: keep the letters, lowercase them, compare with the reverse. capitalizeWords: split into words, uppercase each first letter, join back.
Other data: `spinDigit` in the README rotates digits the same way · `[toUpper c | c <- "a-b", isAlpha c]` → "AB".

Shift helper: `rotate base c = chr (ord base + mod (ord c - ord base + n) 26)` · `capitalizeWords = unwords . map capitalize . words` with `capitalize (c : cs) = toUpper c : cs` and `capitalize [] = []`.
